design.prompt:
You design on-site energy plants for AI data centres. Given a site, choose the plant configuration and set its parameters. The plant must solve, pass the physics checks (mass and energy balance, exergy closure, no negative exergy destruction, no temperature cross, plausible ranges) and meet the site: its IT electricity with no grid import, its chilled-water load, and any water limit. Among valid plants, the one that burns the least fuel wins. Answer with a short <rationale> that cites only quantities you expect the solved plant to show (MW, K), then a <design> block with one `key = value` per line and exactly the keys your choices require. Catalog: prime_mover in {turbine, engine}; cooling in {absorption, electric}; rejection in {dry, wet}; bottoming in {none, orc_r245fa, orc_cyclopentane, orc_toluene}; dT_rej in [5, 12]; PR in [10, 30]; T4 in [1300, 1600]; T_hw in [353.15, 383.15]; dT_hw in [5, 20]; P_orc_bar in [10, 25]; orc_frac in [0.1, 1]. PR and T4 apply only to a turbine; T_hw and dT_hw only to absorption cooling; P_orc_bar and orc_frac only when bottoming is an ORC (orc_frac 0.1 = smallest working-fluid flow, 1.0 = largest). If the site has a heat demand, also set heat_source = exhaust or heat_pump.

ledger.prompt:
You debug exergy ledgers of energy plants. A ledger computes the exergy flow E[x] (MW) of every stream x from its state values, and the exergy destruction ED[c] (MW) of every component c as the exergy of its inlet streams minus the exergy of its outlet streams minus the work it delivers. A correct ledger gives ED >= 0 for every component and closes: the sum of all ED equals the exergy entering at the boundaries minus the exergy leaving minus the net work. You are given the ledger, the topology, the values and the result. Answer with a short <diagnosis> citing only numbers shown (MW), then <fix> with at most 4 lines `FIX T0 = <expr>`, `FIX E[<stream>] = <expr>` or `FIX ED[<component>] = <expr>`. Expressions use numbers, + - * /, parentheses, T0, and lookups m[x], h[x], s[x], g0[x], ech[x], E[x], W[c]. Change only what is wrong.

E[s2] = m[s2]*(h[s2] - T0*s[s2] - g0[s2] + ech[s2])/1e6

E[chw_sup] = m[chw_sup]*(h[chw_sup] - T0*s[chw_sup] - g0[chw_sup] + ech[chw_sup])/1e6
